title: The work classes -- how heavy a change's path is, decided by its consequence (ADR-025)
description: SHIPPED by the delivery capability. The undo-cost scale and the record vocabulary are ORDERED words; each class names the most consequential change it admits, the records it requires and the acts that need the owner's door. No number lives here: how many areas a class may span is the host's, in its areas declaration.

undo.description: The undo-cost scale, cheapest first. An area declares one of these; a change carries the highest among the areas it touches.

uncertainty.description: How much of the answer is unknown when the work is shaped (the Cynefin domains), each with the lightest class work of that kind may walk. Declared on a card at shaping; it can only raise the card's class.

evidence.description: What a proof's reading is worth -- the claim ladder (ISO/IEC/IEEE 15026: a claim is as strong as its evidence). Rows marked `ladder` are ordered weakest first and a stronger one satisfies a weaker need; the others are judgements of their own kind and satisfy only themselves. Each row names the kinds of proof whose reading it is worth; a criterion may name the class it needs.

yielded_by.description: The kinds of proof whose reading is worth this class -- kinds the resolver modules provide. A kind named by no row yields no class of its own (a reading made of other readings); a kind named by two rows is refused.

records.description: The closed vocabulary of what a class may require a change to leave behind.

held_by.description: Where a card holds this record, and from which state on it must: a card FIELD present and not empty, CHILDREN hanging under it, or a CRITERION that needs a class of evidence. A record with no `held_by` is held outside the card (the commit).

criterion_needs.description: Held by a criterion that needs this evidence class: declared on the card, and proved when the criteria are.

kind_of_record.description: The kind of record the field must point at: a document whose front matter declares `kind: <this>` (a decision is an ADR, never the card a finding was captured from).

trailers.description: The git trailer keys a commit message names its card and its declared class with (git interpret-trailers form: `Key: value` in the last paragraph).

working_states.description: The card states a commit may name its card in: work is committed to a card that is being built, never to one that is still being shaped or has already landed.

classes.description: Lightest first. The computed class of a change is the first row whose `admits` holds it; a row with no `admits` is never computed, only declared.

admits.description: The most consequential change this class holds: the highest undo cost, by its id on the scale.

expedite.description: Declared only, never computed: the change may land at any weight now and owes the records of its computed class afterwards (ADR-025 decision 6).

requires.description: Record ids from `records`, every one owed by a change of this class.

doors.description: What only the owner may decide for a change of this class, in words.

aligned_with.description: The external practice this row follows -- alignment, never a compliance claim.

drafted_areas.description: The areas `areas` drafts for every host beside a build tool's modules: the kit's planes (their paths are the planes the host's capabilities draw) and the shared ones (prose). Data, so the drafter holds no policy (ADR-025 amendment 4).

rung.description: the area's undo cost, as a rung of `undo`, cheapest 0
